passages.note: Senate floor final passage of AB 1955 as amended in the Senate; Archuleta voted Aye, 29-8 (over 10% No).

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Operative Section 220.5 forbids local rules requiring disclosure without consent; it does not mandate secrecy (rung 1) and bars disclosure-on-request or notification rules (rungs 3-5); the Senate vote was on this Senate-amended text.

rows.reasoning: Archuleta voted Aye on Senate final passage of AB 1955 (2023-2024), a single-subject pupil-rights bill whose operative Section 220.5 says schools "shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose" a pupil's gender identity without consent. That matches "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents"; the bill does not require staff to withhold the information, so "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents" is not established.
